app.description: web = HTTP app with a baseUrl; wpf = WPF-only, no HTTP server, SQL-side correctness + launch-smoke.

baseUrl.description: HTTP origin for a web app. Omit for a WPF-only app.

db.description: Live source DB (e.g. CKB). Fill per-run to mirror the app's source connection string.

cacheDb.description: Cache DB the app reads at runtime (e.g. ReportingDashboardCache). Falls back to db if unset.

items.description: Either a SQL-only cache check (cacheSql [+ sourceSql] + rule) or a legacy web check (sql + ui).

tab.description: UI badge/element the count backs (documentation of intent, e.g. tabc-store).

cacheSql.description: COUNT query against the cache DB.

sourceSql.description: Independent COUNT against the live source; used with rule cacheEqualsSource.

emptyCase.description: Marks an assertion whose correct answer is currently 0 — exercises real-vs-mock divergence.

ui.description: Legacy web mode: value computed from /api/summary.
